title: Correct a chart after its source changes
summary: Apply a source correction, replace affected claims explicitly, and preserve the context a later reader needs.

identity.availability: Verified source checkout guidance; npm package, hosted site and MCP deployment identities require separate checks.

job: A source value changed. Update the chart and identify conclusions that still need review.
dataShape: Synthetic regional totals: North 12, South 30, West 18. Correct West to 36; the new total is 78 and West becomes largest.
fit: Use when published chart claims and source identity must remain inspectable across revisions.
Artifact sidecars are optional; ordinary chart rendering remains available without project notes.
exclusions: A matching hash does not authenticate the source or prove arbitrary prose true.
A generated revision or transfer report does not grant publication approval or record a human review.

api.name: BarChart
api.description: Vertical or horizontal bars for categorical comparisons.

title.description: Visible chart title and the chart's accessible name.

description.description: Concise accessible description that overrides the chart's generated aria-label.

summary.description: Screen-reader-only summary of the chart's key takeaway; include keyboard interaction guidance when relevant.

accessibleTable.description: Expose the chart data through Semiotic's screen-reader data table. Object form `{ portalTarget: string }` relocates its interactive UI to the DOM element with that ID.

portalTarget.description: ID of a DOM element outside any consumer-owned role=img wrapper. React callers may also pass an Element or a callback through the typed API.

api.schemaScope: Selected properties copied from ai/schema.json; retrieve the component resource for the full schema. React push mode follows the included behavior contracts.

contracts.title: Accessible chart text uses direct chart props
contracts.summary: High-level charts expose title for the visible name, description for a concise accessible description, summary for a screen-reader-only takeaway and interaction guidance, and accessibleTable for the data-table fallback.
contracts.action: Put title, description, summary, and accessibleTable directly on the chart component when they appear in its schema. If a consumer-owned role=img wraps the chart, use accessibleTable: { portalTarget: "element-id" } and render that target outside the image. For generated L1–L3 description or a navigable chart tree, use ChartContainer with chartConfig plus describe and/or navigable; do not invent frameProps fields.

contracts.title: Data required by usage mode
contracts.summary: Static usage (`renderChart`, MCP previews, SSR snapshots, and copy/paste examples with immediate data) requires data in props. React push mode selects live ingestion by omitting data and mutating through a ref.
contracts.action: Pass usageMode="push" to `semiotic-ai --doctor` when validating ref-based JSX with no data prop. Keep usageMode="static" or omit it for renderChart/MCP/static configs where data must be present.

contracts.title: renderChart uses static props only
contracts.summary: MCP renderChart and semiotic/server renderChart render a single static SVG/PNG snapshot. Browser-only realtime components and future ref pushes are not renderable through that path.
contracts.action: Use renderChart only with renderable HOC components and complete static data. For live behavior, return React code with a ref and do not promise MCP-rendered output.

examples.title: Source correction and portable context
Example styles

evidence.statement: Apply a source correction, replace affected claims explicitly, and preserve the context a later reader needs.

observed.authorship: Agent-observed execution of repository tests; independent review is not recorded.

evidence.validity: Only the content digests and environment recorded here; not a release range or an adoption result.
evidence.invalidation: Changes to runtime source, schemas, manifests, task examples, tests, verification tooling or this task definition invalidate the recorded result.
expected: Changing data without revisiting active claims is refused.
The original total 60 and South-largest claims are superseded; replacements describe total 78 and West 36.
The original chart and evidence remain intact while corrected identities change.
Exported context retains the revision history; image-only delivery reports missing context.
Publication and human-review obligations remain visible.
unassessed: Authenticity of upstream data and the truth of arbitrary editorial statements.
Independent human review, publication policy and reader reception.
Benefits to fresh-agent maintenance: the offline study defines cases but measures no adoption outcome.

recovery.action: Supply explicit transitions for every affected active claim. Retain prior evidence and give the correction a distinct revision and new source identity.
recovery.recheck: Inspect superseded claims, replacement IDs, correction history and remaining manual obligations.

recovery.symptom: A recipient has the image but cannot inspect source or review context.
recovery.action: Provide chart config/data and an optional artifact packet or adjacent sidecar. The sidecar contains the contract and transfer report, not a complete dataset.
recovery.recheck: Check the transfer's omissions. Treat unavailable context as unknown; do not manufacture approval.

continuation.rationale: A published regional comparison needs source and claim continuity through a correction.
recheck: Affected arithmetic, ranking, source identity, claim transitions and review obligations after a change.
continuation.loss: Removing a project note does not break the chart. Image-only transfer loses inspectable source/review context; retain config/data separately from the artifact sidecar.

update.previousAssumption: Updating source rows or matching an identity automatically refreshes all conclusions and approves publication.
update.action: Use explicit claim transitions for the changed source, preserve old evidence and inspect correction history, transfer losses and outstanding human review.
recheck: Both total and ranking claims must change in this fixture.
A matching version string does not establish deployed parity or source authenticity.
update.remaining: This is current source guidance with no recorded release introduction or editorial approval.
